title: Medikal Turizm Lead Yonetimi
subtitle: Medical Tourism Pipeline
description: Istanbul'daki kliniklere Ingilizce/Arapca/Rusca gelen yuksek degerli medikal turizm lead'lerini 7/24 AI ile karsilayan, on degerlendirme yapan ve follow-up zinciri ile randevuya donusturen sistem.

overview.servicesNote: 7/24 otomatik cevap (EN/AR/RU). AI on degerlendirme + lead scoring + otomatik follow-up zinciri.

steps.title: 7/24 Ilk Cevap (30sn)
steps.content: Gece 3'te Suudi'den mesaj gelse bile 30 saniyede otomatik cevap. Multi-language NLP ile dil tespit + cevap.

steps.title: On Degerlendirme
steps.content: Hastadan fotograf, saglik durumu ve ziyaret plani istenir. AI on degerlendirme yapar.

steps.title: Lead Scoring
steps.content: Budget, timeline, readiness bazli lead score hesaplanir. Sicak lead → doktora/koordinatore bildirim.

steps.title: Follow-Up Zinciri
steps.content: T+0: Ilk cevap (30sn). T+1: 'Fotograflari gonderdiniz mi?' T+3: 'Size ozel paket hazirladik.' T+7: 'Gecen hafta 3 hasta geldi [before/after].'

client.hint: Ingilizce tedavi paketlerini ve fiyatlarini Knowledge Base'e yukleyin
Otel, transfer ve paket detaylarini tanimlayin

provider.hint: Ingilizce NLP ve cevap uretimi hazir

steps.content: Hi, how much for hair transplant? FUE 3000 grafts.
Language: English. Intent: Price + Hair Transplant. Lead Score: HIGH.

Thank you for your interest! To give you an accurate quote, we need:
1. A photo of your current hair situation
2. Your general health condition
3. When are you planning to visit Istanbul?
Here's my photo [image]. I'm healthy. Planning for March.
Photo received. Pre-assessment: Norwood 3-4. Estimated: 3000-3500 grafts. Lead READY.
Based on your photo, we recommend FUE 3000-3500 grafts. Our all-inclusive package: $2,500 (hotel 3 nights + airport transfer + PRP). Shall I schedule a video consultation with our doctor?
Hot Lead: UK patient, March timeline, $2,500 package. Doctor notified.

7/24 otomatik cevap sistemi hazir — gece/gunduz farketmez

steps.content: Saat: 03:15 (Turkiye). Kaynak: Instagram Reklami (Suudi Arabistan).
مرحبا، كم سعر زراعة الأسنان؟
Language: Arabic. Intent: Dental Implant Price. Time: 03:15 AM. Auto-response activated.

مرحباً! شكراً لتواصلك معنا. لتقديم عرض دقيق، نحتاج:
1. صورة أشعة بانوراما
2. حالتك الصحية العامة
3. متى تخطط لزيارة إسطنبول؟
Lead created: Saudi Arabia, Dental Implant, Night inquiry. Follow-up chain: T+1 activated.

flows.title: Follow-Up Zinciri
flows.description: Lead cevap vermedi, otomatik takip mesajlari.

client.hint: Tedavi oncesi/sonrasi gorsellerini ve hasta referanslarini yukleyin
Hasta basari hikayeleri ve referanslari yukleyin

provider.hint: Ingilizce ve Arapca template mesajlar hazir

steps.content: T+1 Gun: Lead henuz fotograf gondermedi.
Hi [Name]! Did you have a chance to send the photos? We're ready to prepare your personalized treatment plan.
T+3 Gun: Hala cevap yok.
We prepared a special package for you! All-inclusive dental treatment + 5 nights hotel + VIP transfer. Limited spots for March. Interested?
T+7 Gun: Son deneme.
Last week, 3 patients from the UK visited us. Here are their results: [Before/After photos]. We'd love to help you too!
Follow-up zinciri tamamlandi. Lead durumu: SOGUK → pasife alindi.

tech.note: Bu senaryo 7/24 aktif olmalidır. Multi-language NLP ile dil tespiti ve cevap uretimi yapilir. Lead scoring budget + timeline + readiness faktorlerine gore hesaplanir.

impact.description: Medikal turizm lead donusum artisi ile elde edilen ek gelir. Her lead 50K-250K TL degeri tasir.
